note: Large RV campground at 31635 SE Ashworth Rd, Waukee, just west of Des Moines and 1.5 miles off I-80: wooded and open sections around a small stocked fishing pond, with cabins, four vintage-camper glamping units (Horseshoe Bend) and tent sites. Some long-term residents. Sister park Timberline East is at Newton. --Claude
summary: Campspot quotes read: $54 water/electric / $59 full hookup confirmed for Nov 2026, Apr and Jul 2027 (+4% card fee, $3 convenience fee, Campspot fee); 30/50 amp, water and sewer confirmed; max rig 70, pull-through; showers/dump/laundry/store/wifi added; booking on Campspot with deposit/cancellation rules. Over the $50 line; passes only on the Good Sam 10% ($48.60).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: cheapest real RV night $54 (water/electric, offered to motorhomes up to 70 ft) in every season sampled (2026-11-10, 2027-04-13, 2027-07-13) - OVER the US$50 gate, no gateway within 40 km (Kansas City 282 km), family has not stayed. It is a Good Sam Park in the Good Sam directory (gs true), so the 10% brings it to $48.60, the AWH 2026-10-14 exception. The operator's own pages and Campspot never mention Good Sam (no discount offered in the online quote), so the discount rests on the directory alone. Online booking also adds a 4% card processing fee ($2.16) and a $3 campground convenience fee per stay plus Campspot's ~$3 booking fee; per-stay fees are not counted, the card fee is a payment surcharge. RV Life reviewers in 9-11/2026 report paying $60-73 a night (no discount), which looks like tax and fees on $54-59.
REVIEWS: Google 4.5 / 796; Campspot 4.7 / 59; RV Life 4.5 (park 1137). The operator site's Google widget shows 4.4. Nothing under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

LONG-STAY: not mostly seasonal. Campspot sells 93-153 RV sites by the night; monthly rates 'Contact us directly'. RV Life reviewers: 9/2026 'They have lots of full time residents' (Labor Day stay) and 9/2026 'Large spacious property with RV storage, solar and permanent and semi permanent RVs.' Five tests: 1 price over $50 but passes on the GS exception; 2 Campspot sells one night; 3 no minimum seen; 4 far more than 1 site in 10 nightly; 5 an RV park, no homes or lots for sale seen. Pass.

WATERFRONT 'pond' STANDS (checked): the pond is ~77 x 52 m of open water (about 0.8 acre), under 5 acres so a pond. On imagery at 0.2 m/px, 3-4 back-in pads at the south end of the north cul-de-sac loop end ~18-25 m from the water's reed fringe across open lawn, with no road between; the pond's west side is a row of cabins on a gravel lot and its south side the park road. So a few RV pads on the pond.
PIN OK: stored 41.5785,-93.8720 is in the main pull-through block (Google 41.57903,-93.87348 is the office); within 250 m of the sites' centre.
